Name: StarAmy's Farm Animals for Alternative Texture
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
For those of us who need as many variations in our farm animals as possible - I present to you a conversion of the lovely StarAmy's Farm Animals for Alternative Textures!

I received permission from Amy to convert her mod (original can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12294]HERE[/url]) and I just adore these cute animals so I hope they make your gameplay even more adorable. :)

Simply download, unzip and place in your Mods folder! Just don't forget to also download Alternative Textures if you haven't already because it won't work without it.
